text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Ooh... this looks pretty sweet! The 'Exciting ☆ Jungle Lunch'!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Lion-faced omurice, huh... Hehe♪
Now where's the order tablet—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ..."Due to popular demand,
this collab item is currently sold out"...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The hell?! Why's it sold out?!
I was totally in the mood for omurice, too... Dammit!

Unable to order the menu item she wanted,
Jungle Pocket's mood plummeted.
